title: D is for David — The Boy Who Trusted God
objective: Students will learn the letter D and the Bible word David, a brave boy who trusted God.
content: Today we are learning the letter D! Can you say D? D is for David!
David was a young boy who loved God very much. He took care of his father's sheep. He was brave and kind.
One day, a big giant named Goliath tried to scare everyone. But David was not afraid because he trusted God! God helped David be brave and strong. David became a great king!
activity: Color a picture of the letter D. Draw a picture of David with his sheep or being brave.
discussion: Can you say the letter D?
What animals did David take care of?
